getSecretLogicHash(uint256).details: Access control: only offChainAgent can call this. The agent fetches the prompt from IPFS using the CID;      no other address can read the CID from the contract, so only the AI agent can resolve and use the secret logic.

deposits(address,uint256).notice: user => strategyId => MON deposited (only these users can have funds used by agent trades)

follow(uint256).notice: Follow a strategy by depositing MON. Only these users have funds that can be used by the strategy's agent.

getSecretLogicHash(uint256).notice: Returns secretLogicHash (IPFS CID) only to the off-chain agent.

offChainAgent().notice: Off-chain AI agent; only this address can trigger trades for followers and read secretLogicHash.

registerStrategy(string,string,string).notice: Register a strategy with public (name, bio) and secret (IPFS CID) metadata.

triggerAgentTrade(uint256,address[],addr.notice: Trigger swaps for multiple followers in one tx. Only offChainAgent. Funds are only taken from users who have followed (deposited).

updateAgentAddress(address).notice: Owner-only: update the off-chain agent address (agent governance).
